Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning assisted living facility medicaid minimum occupancy of fifty percent or greater.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to assisted living facility medicaid minimumoccupancy percentage of fifty percent or greater; adding a new sectionto chapter 74.39A RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.39A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department shall establish a capital addon rate, not lessthan the July 1, 2005, capital addon rate established by thedepartment, for those assisted living facilities contracting with thedepartment that have a medicaid minimum occupancy percentage of sixtypercent or greater. The medicaid minimum occupancy percentage shall bedetermined on an annual basis. In determining whether an assistedliving facility meets the medicaid minimum occupancy percentageestablished under this section, the department shall include in thecalculation of medicaid days those clients who are enrolled in amanaged care delivery system for receipt of long-term care services,including but not limited to the program for all inclusive care and themedicaid integration project. p. 1 ESHB 2925 (2) This section applies to assisted living facility ratesestablished on or after January 1, 2006.
If specific funding for the purposes of thisact, referencing this act by bill or chapter number, is not provided byJune 30, 2006, in the omnibus appropriations act, this act is null andvoid.
